NOON REPORT - MV TORMAR SPRING
Date/time: 23 Jan 2025 1200 (ship's time UTC)

Consumption last 24h: VLSFO 24.8 t, MGO 0.1 t
Next port: Sept-Iles
ETA Sept-Iles: 2025-01-30 2100 UTC
ETA based on: 12.5 kn
Remarks: All bunker tanks sounded today; VLSFO ROB corrected by -3.5 t. Wind and sea increasing from W in the afternoon.

Master MV TORMAR SPRING
